summary: Cayson Acquisition Corp (a SPAC) filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to its merger agreement with Mango Financial Group Limited. The amendment extends the outside termination date for the closing of the business combination from June 24, 2026 to March 23, 2027. No financial terms, consideration structure, or premiums are stated. The SPAC's board did not issue a new recommendation in this filing. A registration statement on Form F-4 has been filed with the SEC. The extension gives the parties additional time to satisfy closing conditions. Watch for shareholder vote on the merger and potential redemptions that could affect the deal's viability.
